_doc: Vectors of mlcc_dielectrics. Expected values are the KEMET and TDK datasheet numbers and the EIA RS-198 code reading of the research file, in the unit of the column.

cells.ref: X7R: -55 to +125 degC, +-15 %: KEMET C1002 and TDK MLCC Product Guide agree
X7R: +-15 % over the range: KEMET C1002 and TDK MLCC Product Guide agree
X5R: -55 to +85 degC: KEMET C1006 and TDK MLCC Product Guide agree
C0G: 0 +-30 ppm/degC: KEMET C1003 and TDK MLCC Product Guide agree
C0G: 0 ppm/degC: KEMET C1003 and TDK MLCC Product Guide agree
C0G is class I: a temperature coefficient, no capacitance-change limits
Y5V: +22 %/-82 %, -30 to +85 degC: KEMET C1005 and the EIA code reading (V = +22/-82 %)
Y5V: lower limit -30 degC (code letter Y): KEMET C1005 and the EIA code reading
X7T: +22 %/-33 %: TDK MLCC Product Guide and the EIA code reading (T = +22/-33 %)
X8R: -55 to +150 degC, +-15 %: TDK MLCC Product Guide and the EIA code reading (8 = +150 degC)
KEMET C1005: EIA characterizes Y5V dielectric as a Class III material

lookups.ref: X8R (-55 to +150 degC) is the first dielectric in table order that covers more than 126.85 degC (400 K); lower limit -55 degC = 218.15 K
